params.name: categoryID
params.description: Filter by a range or CSV of category IDs.

params.name: parentCategoryID
params.description: Parent category ID.

params.name: parentCategoryCode
params.description: Parent category URL code.

params.name: followed
params.description: Only list categories followed by the current user.

params.name: followedUserID
params.description: List the categories followed by the given UserID

params.name: maxDepth
params.description: The maximum tree depth to return when getting a tree structure. This parameter is incompatible with a flat structure.

params.name: archived
params.description: Filter by archived status of a category. True for archived only. False for no archived categories.

params.name: featured
params.description: Only list featured categories.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. See [Pagination](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/apiv2/#pagination). This parameter is incompatible with a tree structure.

params.name: limit
params.description: Desired number of items per page. This parameter is incompatible with a tree structure.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort the results.

params.name: expand
params.description: Expand associated records using one or more valid field names. A value of "all" will expand all expandable fields.

params.name: siteSectionID
params.description:
Filter categories by site section ID (ex. subcommunity).
The subcommunity ID or folder can be used if you use [smart IDs](https://success.vanillaforums.com/kb/articles/46-smart-ids).
The query looks like:

```
siteSectionID=$subcommunityID:{id|folder}
```
example: "$subcommunityID:en".

params.name: includeParentCategory
params.description: Whether to include the parent category when used with parentCategoryID, parentCategoryCode, or siteSectionID.

params.name: outputFormat
params.description: Format of the output as flat or tree.

params.name: layoutViewType
params.description: Layout View Type.

params.name: postTypeID
params.description: Filter by allowed post type ID

params.name: postTypeStatus
params.description: Allowed status for the post type ID filter.
